questiontext.text: Which of the following statements accurately describe Ruth's character and actions in the Book of Ruth? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Ruth showed steadfast devotion, humble diligence, and noble moral character (Ruth 1:16; 2:7; 3:11). She never complained about her hardships.

name.text: W08_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following expressions of kindness did Boaz extend to Ruth in his fields? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Boaz gave Ruth protection, water, food at his table, and open gleaning rights without charging any fee (Ruth 2:8-16).

name.text: W08_Q19: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each person in the Book of Ruth with their description:

generalfeedback.text: Naomi was restored; Ruth made the vow; Boaz was kinsman-redeemer; and Obed was father of Jesse.

questiontext.text: Match each biblical term from the Book of Ruth with its meaning:

generalfeedback.text: Mara means bitter; gleaning is gathering grain; kinsman-redeemer preserves lineage; and Bethlehem means house of bread.
